## India: Regulatory & Judicial Updates

India's IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced the finalization of the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Rules, indicating their imminent publication. This crucial step follows the passage of the DPDP Act last year, paving the way for its full implementation. Concurrently, the Kerala High Court directed the government to operationalize the Data Protection Board within eight weeks, prompting MeitY to invite applications for the Board's Chairperson and members, signaling a concrete move towards establishing the enforcement body.

These challenges raise fundamental questions about the law's validity, potentially impacting its future enforcement and interpretation.

## India: DPDPA Implementation & Sectoral Impact

The government itself faces a significant data compliance test under the DPDP Act, with ministries and states needing to adapt their data processing practices to the new legal framework. This internal readiness is crucial for effective nationwide implementation. The Act also prompts a re-evaluation of workplace surveillance practices, balancing legitimate employer interests with employee privacy rights in the digital age.
